results.prompt: Instrumental music in the characteristic style of YUAN / 徐梦圆, drawing on the musical character of the reference track "China-Future". Bright electronic EDM centered on a sharp synth-lead motif above punchy electronic drums and bass. A rhythmic opening expands through layered electronic textures, then a brief breakdown creates contrast before the beat and filtered lead return with changed timbre and stronger energy. Keep the melody fully instrumental, with clear sectional development.

Instrumental music in the characteristic style of Xomu, drawing on the musical character of the reference track "Mannenzakura". Electronic drums and deep sub-bass support an uplifting progression through a restrained opening, rising build, full melodic drop, contrasting break and denser final return with expanded synth chords. Keep every section fully instrumental.
